current.text: Washington acquired him from the Lakers for Jaden Hardy and second-round picks. He is the backup big man behind Alex Sarr and Anthony Davis and will come off the bench.
Washington lacks depth at center behind Sarr and Davis.
Davis's health is a question. Because of it, Ayton could get 30-minute roles at times.
The expert says he is no longer the player he was in Phoenix.
His FG% jump last season may have come partly from playing with Luka. He now plays with Trae Young. The expert says not to automatically expect a big FG% drop.
Washington is trying to compete this season. The expert says fantasy managers should no longer face the late-season resting and minutes cuts of past years.

note: Yahoo and ESPN both price him at 0 USD, at ranks 169 and 192. That is outside the 144 players we draft, so the 9 USD he cost in our auction last season is far too high now. As a bench big projected for about 24 minutes, with 9 to 12 points and 7 to 8 rebounds, his value is mostly a strong FG% on low volume and fewer than 1.2 turnovers. He loses nothing for a punt 3PM build. Leave him on waivers and pick him up quickly if Anthony Davis gets hurt, since the notes say he could see 30-minute roles then. Also check early whether his FG% holds up next to Trae Young.
